'''Mariusz Tomasz Lemańczyk''' (born 3 February 1958) is a Polish mathematician known for his contributions in [[ergodic theory]] and [[dynamical systems]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Mariusz Lemańczyk|url=http://www-users.mat.umk.pl/~mlem/cv.php|website=Wydział Matematyki i Informatyki|publisher=Uniwersytetu Mikołaja Kopernika w Toruniu|accessdate=19 July 2017|language=pl}}</ref> 

==Life and career==
He graduated from the [[Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń]] in 1981, in mathematics, and completed his PhD in 1985. In 1987, he received the [[Kazimierz Kuratowski]] Prize, considered one of the most prestigious awards for young Polish mathematicians.<ref>{{cite web|title=Nagroda im. Kazimierza Kuratowskiego|url=https://www.impan.pl/pl/wydarzenia/nagrody/nagroda-kazimierza-kuratowskiego|website=Instytut Matematyczny Polskiej Akademii Nauk|accessdate=19 July 2017|language=pl|archive-date=18 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160318071344/https://www.impan.pl/pl/wydarzenia/nagrody/nagroda-kazimierza-kuratowskiego|url-status=dead}}</ref> He received his [[habilitation]] at the [[University of Warsaw]] in 1991,<ref>{{cite web|title=prof. dr hab. Mariusz Tomasz Lemańczyk|url=http://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=33517&_k=ax4s2g|website=Nowa Nauka Polska|publisher=National Information Processing Institute|accessdate=19 July 2017|language=pl-PL}}</ref> after which he joined the faculty at [[Nicolaus Copernicus University]]. In 1997, he received the Stefan Banach Prize from the [[Polish Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Nagroda główna PTeM im. Stefana Banacha|url=http://www.ptm.org.pl/kategorie/konkursy/nagrody-glowne-ptm/nagroda-glowna-ptm-im-stefana-banacha?page=2|website=Polskie Towarzystwo Matematyczne|accessdate=19 July 2017|language=pl}}</ref> In 2016, he held the Jean-Morlet Chair at the [[Centre International de Rencontres Mathématiques]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Semesters|url=http://www.chairejeanmorlet.com/semesters.html|website=Chaire Jean-Morlet|accessdate=19 July 2017}}</ref> On December 3rd 2021 he was [https://translate.google.com/translate?hl=ru&prev=_t&sl=pl&tl=en&u=https://informacje.pan.pl/index.php/informacje/materialy-dla-prasy/3498-nowi-czlonkowie-pan-i-amu-pan selected to join] the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]]. In July 2022 he gave an invited lecture entitled '[[Hillel Furstenberg|Furstenberg]] disjointness, [[Marina Ratner|Ratner]] properties and [[Peter Sarnak|Sarnak]]’s conjecture' at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref>[https://www.mathunion.org/fileadmin/IMU/ICM2022/Program/Virtual_ICM_2022_Sectional_Schedule.pdf Virtual ICM 2022 | Sectional Schedule By Day]</ref>
